units.source_text: 车站上任何细微的片断，都被拉向别离和出发的统一的情感世界里了。

en.t: Every tiny fragment of the station was drawn into a unified emotional world of parting and departure.

units.source_text: 在我眼皮下向后退的月台，是多么的大方、有礼地向后退啊。

en.t: The platform retreating beneath my eyes withdrew with such generosity and courtesy.

units.source_text: 这种钢筋水泥的无表情的平面，通过不断从那里移动、别离、出发，使它显得多么的灿烂辉煌啊！

en.t: How brilliantly this expressionless plane of reinforced concrete was made to shine by the ceaseless movement, parting, and departure from it!
